goal_ru: После урока ты сможешь говорить о правилах и давать советы: must, have to, should.
can_do_en: I can talk about rules and give advice with must, have to and should.

words.example_en: You should use a strong password.
Don't meet strangers from the internet alone.
words.example_ru: Не встречайся один с незнакомцами из интернета.

words.example_en: You should turn on two-factor authentication.
Can I give you some advice?
words.note_ru: advice — неисчисляемое: some advice, a piece of advice (не «an advice»).

grammar.title_ru: must / mustn't, have to / don't have to, should / shouldn't
grammar.explain_ru: must — «обязан» (правило, сильно): You must wear a uniform. mustn't — «нельзя»: You mustn't share your password. have to — «приходится, нужно» (внешние обстоятельства): I have to get up at six. don't have to — «не обязательно» (НЕ «нельзя»!): You don't have to come. should — совет «стоит»: You should take a break. shouldn't — «не стоит». После всех — простой глагол без to (кроме have to).
grammar.explain_en: must = strong rule; mustn't = not allowed. have to = necessary; don't have to = not necessary. should = advice. You mustn't share your password. You don't have to come. You should take a break.

examples.en: You mustn't click on strange links — it could be a scam.
examples.ru: Нельзя переходить по странным ссылкам — это может быть мошенничество.

examples.en: At our school we have to wear a uniform, but we don't have to wear a tie.
examples.ru: У нас в школе обязательна форма, но галстук носить не нужно.

examples.en: You should turn on two-factor authentication.

mistakes.wrong: You don't have to share your password (в значении «нельзя»).
mistakes.why_ru: don't have to — «не обязательно», а «нельзя» — mustn't.

grammar.tutor_notes_ru: Самая важная ловушка — mustn't vs don't have to. Тема — цифровая безопасность (полезно и реально) и школьные правила. Нейт — «строгий админ» сервера.

phrases.ru: На твоём месте я бы… (пока — готовой фразой)

questions_en: What are the rules at your school?
What do you have to do at home?
What should people never do online?
What advice would you give a new student?
talk.tutor_notes_ru: Ученик составляет «правила сервера» для своей игровой команды — с must/mustn't/should. Нейт проверяет логику.

tasks.question: It's Saturday — you ___ get up early.

tasks.ask_ru: Вставь must, mustn't, have to, don't have to, should.
tasks.text: You ___ tell anyone your password. You ___ use the same password everywhere — it's risky. You ___ change it every day — once a year is OK.

tasks.ask_ru: Послушай правила лагеря без текста. Что можно НЕ делать?
tasks.ask_en: Listen to the camp rules. What don't you have to do?
tasks.audio: Welcome to camp! You must be in your room by ten. You mustn't leave the camp without a teacher. You don't have to go to the evening disco, but you should try it — it's fun!
tasks.question: Что не обязательно?

tasks.ask_ru: Скриншот подозрительного сообщения. Объясни другу, что это и что ему стоит и нельзя делать.
tasks.ask_en: Explain what this is and give advice.

image.prompt_en: A smartphone screen with a suspicious chat message from an unknown account with a gift box emoji, a big red link button and a timer icon, a game currency icon, flat UI illustration, no readable text
image.alt_ru: Сообщение от неизвестного аккаунта: подарок, большая красная кнопка-ссылка, таймер, иконка игровой валюты — похоже на «бесплатную валюту за вход».

tasks.say: Your friend got this message. What should he do?
tasks.example: This is a scam. They want your password. You mustn't click on the link. You shouldn't answer the message. You should block this account and tell an adult. And you should turn on two-factor authentication.

tasks.ask_ru: Составь «правила сервера» для своей игровой команды или чата: 3 must/mustn't, 2 should, 1 don't have to.
tasks.ask_en: Write the rules for your team's chat.
tasks.say: You're the admin now. Give me the rules of your server.
tasks.example: Rule one: you must be polite. You mustn't share other people's photos. You mustn't spam. You should help new players. You should report scams. You don't have to play every day — it's just for fun.

homework.about_ru: Расскажи Нейту, какие правила у тебя дома и в школе: что обязательно, что нельзя, что не обязательно — и одно правило, которое ты бы поменял.

tasks.ask_en: Rules at home and at school.
tasks.say: Rules at home and at school. And one rule you'd change.
tasks.example: At school we have to wear a uniform and we mustn't use phones in class. At home I have to walk the dog, but I don't have to cook. I think schools shouldn't start at eight — it's too early!

pass.about_ru: Пройден, если верно 75% заданий и в правилах (t5) mustn't и don't have to различены верно.
